Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Hoh-Jun (hybrid tea, Suzuki, 1981)
Exhibition name: Hoh-Jun
rows.Origin:
Bred by Seizo Suzuki (Japan, before 1981).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 1981 as 'Hoh-Jun'.
rows.Bloom: Pink. Strong fragrance. 28 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage:
Granada (hybrid tea, Lindquist, 1963) ×
Flaming Peace (Hybrid Tea, McGredy, 1966)
